provenance_rules: Book descriptions and table readings are historical source claims, not human predictive validation.
Original Tibetan, embedded translation, commentary, worked example, and this project's own inference have separate authority.
Mark derived ideas overlapping Chinese BaZi or Indian Jyotish as dependent; no double count independent confirmations.
Do not silently choose among incompatible Tibetan computational or classificatory variants.
Keep input dependencies: birth time, parents' birth years, divination time and place, sex-specific conventions, remedy/ritual intervention.
Do not check known life stories to fit the new system; use sealed human tests and untouched participants when model freezes.
Do not commit copyrighted PDF bytes or personal participant data; preserve local witness hashes, exact page anchors and paraphrases.
